This consultation asks about our second proposed guideline, setting out the sentencing
process. The guideline explains the steps taken by courts when they decide what sentence
should be imposed, and the various factors that they consider.
And we are preparing another general guideline, on the sentencing of young people, to
reflect the complexities in dealing with such cases.
In addition to these introductory guidelines, we announced in our business plan our intention
to develop guidelines which apply to particular offences. We expect that the first of our
offence guidelines will relate to offences of causing death by driving. Further information
about the guidelines we are developing, and the way in which we do that, can be found on
our website.
